handover_state_consistent.name: handover_state_consistent
handover_state_consistent.value: ("handover"."status" = 'draft' and "handover"."delivered_by" is null and "handover"."delivered_at" is null and "handover"."confirmed_by" is null and "handover"."confirmed_at" is null) or ("handover"."status" = 'delivered' and "handover"."delivered_by" is not null and "handover"."delivered_at" is not null and "handover"."confirmed_by" is null and "handover"."confirmed_at" is null) or ("handover"."status" = 'confirmed' and "handover"."delivered_by" is not null and "handover"."delivered_at" is not null and "handover"."confirmed_by" is not null and "handover"."confirmed_at" is not null)
